selected_problem: Fresh-main inspection found that acceptance validation now strips ambient process variables, but POSIX runCommand still launched /bin/bash -lc. A login shell can source user-level startup profiles before the validation command, reintroducing ambient configuration, secrets or side effects outside the explicit validation environment.

decision_provenance.mode_route_basis: The committed four-mode router selects DEEP_DEVELOPMENT through the singular evidence-rich bottleneck gate; no mode rotation was forced.
decision_provenance.claim_limit: No hosted DWAC success receipt is claimed. Selection/routing come from committed DWAC source-contract replay over the fresh canonical main while the hosted Developer Execution Runtime remained transiently unavailable.

pre_fix_reproduction.posix_login_profile_injection: PASS reproduced on the validation host against the canonical-base source: a temporary login profile exported TAOWIND_PROFILE_SECRET=profile-loaded; runAcceptance executed through /bin/bash -lc and the validation child printed profile-loaded despite inheritProcessEnv=false.

changes: runCommand now exposes a bounded isolatedShell option while preserving the previous login-shell behavior for existing callers by default.
POSIX isolatedShell invocation uses /bin/bash --noprofile --norc -c; Windows remains on powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command.
runAcceptance explicitly requests isolatedShell=true in addition to the existing minimal environment and inheritProcessEnv=false controls.
Persistent interactive terminal behavior is unchanged; the isolation is scoped to one-shot autonomous acceptance validation.
A focused regression test locks the isolated POSIX invocation contract.

validation.post_fix_witness: With the same temporary login profile witness, runAcceptance returned missing rather than profile-loaded.

truth_boundaries: This closes POSIX login/profile startup injection for acceptance validation; it is not an OS-level sandbox.
Validation commands can still access filesystem paths permitted to the Taowind Code process, including absolute paths outside the workspace; full workspace confinement remains unresolved.
The validation environment still intentionally exposes a small set of execution variables and may require evidence-driven compatibility adjustments for some toolchains.
Arbitrary complex repository semantic synthesis remains UNRESOLVED.
Filesystem crash-level atomicity for arbitrary I/O/process failure remains unresolved.
No GitHub Actions were intentionally triggered or rerun, no force push was used, and no credential, payment, formal Release or destructive/irreversible external action was performed.
